subject: MAS adds Bank Negara Malaysia and Bank of Thailand to BLOOM cross-border digital money initiative
text:
Source: MAS media release, 23 Oct 2026 https://www.mas.gov.sg/news/media-releases/2026/mas-bnm-and-bot-partner-with-industry-to-advance-cross-border-settlement-in-digital-money (source.mjs reads it; mirror https://www.malaymail.com/news/singapore/2026/10/23/bnm-bank-of-thailand-join-singapore-led-bloom-cross-border-digital-money-initiative/240359)
Why it fits: SEA desk plus payments. MAS, Bank Negara Malaysia and the Bank of Thailand are setting common settlement approaches for tokenised deposits and regulated stablecoins, with Maybank, ShopeePay, Visa, Mastercard and the World Bank Group as participants. 23 Oct, so say the date in the body. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
